You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:patient_data_exposure: Patient-data access or exposure always goes to a human. (also matched: prescription_error) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Medication out of stock alerts and substitutions

Hello, I recently received an alert that one of our commonly prescribed medications is out of stock at local pharmacies. Could you remind me of the steps to handle substitution messaging and switch the prescription to an alternative therapeutic agent within the patient chart?

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hello,

Thank you for contacting us about the medication out‑of‑stock alert and the process for handling substitution messaging and switching prescriptions within the patient chart. I understand how important it is to manage these situations efficiently.

A member of our support team is reviewing your request and will get back to you shortly to assist further.

Best regards,
[Your Support Team]"
}
